name: council-of-ai
what: Independent AI-behaviour measurement, packaged for AI platforms. Pull the live GSPC board, verify Ed25519 measurement cards offline, seal artifacts, and census the local harness.
not: Not a certification, not a badge, not a ranking sold as a verdict. The board and verification are free, forever, for everyone.

gspc.description: Council of AI GSPC measurement board: live axes, signed card index, three-state verification, free forever.

csoai-governance.description: CSOAI Layer-0 governance: seal bytes with Ed25519 and verify the seal. A receipt, never a certificate.

doctrine: MEASURED is a run behind a slot. UNMEASURED is an answer, never 0.
SEPARATED / TIE / UNTESTED are three states.
We never score our own products.
A count with no source is null, never 0.
